featured_reviews.name: Anurag Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently enrolled at IMS for my CAT preparation, and the experience has been exceptional. The structured curriculum and the resources provided are great, but the real value lies in the mentorship.

A huge thank you to Ahmer Sir, my QA and DILR mentor. I was struggling to see progress in my Quant scores for a while, but after implementing the specific strategies and 'short-cut' techniques he taught, I saw a significant jump in my QA scores within just a week. His ability to simplify the most daunting DILR sets and turn them into logical puzzles is incredible. He doesn't just teach you how to solve a problem; he teaches you how to think, which is crucial for an exam like CAT.

I also want to express my gratitude to Souvik Sir for his guidance in VA. His sessions have completely changed my approach to Reading Comprehension. He brings a lot of clarity to the Verbal section, making it much easier to eliminate options and improve accuracy in what can often be a confusing subject.

Beyond the teaching, the environment at this center is very friendly and encouraging. It doesn't feel like a high-pressure coaching factory; the staff and mentors are approachable, and there is a genuine sense of support among the students. Whether it’s clearing doubts or just getting a bit of motivation, I’ve always felt welcome here.

Highly recommended for any CAT aspirant looking for personalized attention and a positive study atmosphere!

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: S Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined IMS(Andheri West branch) this year in August, to prepare for the CAT-2025 exam. I scored 94.02 percentile overall in the CAT exam this year, and I wholeheartedly attribute this success to IMS. The faculty at IMS Andheri West is extremely experienced and learned.

Our batch had Mohammad Ahmer Khan Sir for both Quant and DILR, and the manner in which he simplifies and breaks down concepts for students before delving deeper into the topic, helped me a lot to get a grasp on what the topic aims to convey, especially since I have been weak in the Quants section. I ended up with a 97.98 percentile in DILR, a section which I had found the most difficult in my CAT prep journey, but which became my greatest strength when the results thus came out.

For VARC, we had Ma'am Vanita Sanjay and Ma'am Sonia Saxena, both of whom are excellent faculties in their field. They taught us verbal ability in a methodical manner, with proper explanation of the arrangement of sentences.

We had morning classes at 7 am and although it was daunting at the beginning, to attend classes so early in the morning, I gradually started to enjoy as our course progressed and the concepts were made easier for us to understand. The SIMCATs, time to time whatsapp group alerts for extra masterclasses and offline ADMAT classes, as well as the modules/books that were received via courier from IMS before the classes began, helped me to amp up my preparation. I gained a solid idea about the exam and its components, and prepared accordingly. the Faculties were always available on Whatsapp as well as calls to answer doubts related to the syllabus, specific topics etc.

I also thank the centre incharges Ma'am Aasha Mahanta and Ma'am Apoorva for guiding me smoothly throughout the process of admission to IMS, enlightening me about the IIM selection process and for always being available to address various doubts and queries that arose from time to time.

It was a memorable time at IMS, and I highly recommend anyone who aims to appear for MBA exams like CAT, SNAP, NMAT, XAT, CMAT etc. to join IMS. It would help greatly in your exam journey and will give you a direction to structure your preparation for the same.

IMS Andheri has been instrumental in my CAT preparation journey. The centre is well-organized and extremely student-friendly. Their resources including the IMS portal, SIMCATs, sectionals, and study material are comprehensive and aligned with the demands of the CAT exam.

I’d like to extend my heartfelt thanks to Mohammad Ahmer Khan Sir, my QA and DILR mentor. His intuitive teaching methods, and ability to break down even the most complex topics made quant and DILR far less intimidating. His sessions were always interactive and focused on real exam application, which helped build my confidence tremendously.

For Verbal Ability, I was guided by Manav Sarmal Sir. His logical and structured approach to VARC made all the difference in my preparation. Manav Sir’s classes were analytical and insightful, and his guidance on reading strategies and RC techniques was particularly impactful.

A special shout-out to Apoorva Madam, the Centre Incharge, who ensured smooth administration throughout. From scheduling to resolving queries promptly, she played a big role in creating a stress-free learning environment.
Overall, I highly recommend IMS Andheri to anyone serious about cracking CAT. The faculty, resources, and overall experience are top-notch
